ocrDiagnostic.method: Separate diagnostic one-shot runs with only one model profiling at a time, original weights and image dimensions, intra-op 2 and graph optimization 99; local image only. Profiling overhead and separate runs mean durations must not be summed or used as production latency claims.
ocrDiagnostic.conclusion: Recognition model execution is the principal remaining OCR cost; no image downsampling, orientation disabling, model replacement, or thread-count change was made this round.
